changes.title: Call or ask for a quote from the dock.
changes.text: The current homepage shrinks to a tiny desktop page on a phone, the number can't be tapped, and there is no way to ask for a quote. The concept puts tap to call and a quote request with photo upload at the top.

changes.title: Your work, big and up front.
changes.text: Your refinishing before and after photos sit on an inner page today. The concept leads with them so a boat owner sees the quality first.

changes.title: Free pickup and both locations in plain sight.
changes.text: Free delivery and pickup, Dickinson and Seabrook, and insurance claim work are all on the homepage, on a secure site browsers don't flag as Not Secure.
